I want to express my enormous gratitude to the entire Kivet Matosinhos team.

To Dr. António, who has cared for my pets for 19 years, including my oldest one—always with complete dedication, respect, and genuine care that has given me absolute confidence throughout all these years.

To Francisca, who is simply incredible—someone I truly love. She is always ready to help, find solutions, and welcome us with a kindness and affection that makes all the difference. She is a very special person on that team.

To Dr. Micaela, a veterinarian with her heart in the right place, who demonstrates rare empathy and humanity.

Recently, I had to make one of the most difficult decisions: saying goodbye to my boy, who was family to me. I know that Dr. António did everything possible to provide him with a long and comfortable life.

But I can't help but thank the entire team for their support during such a painful time—I know it's hard for you too, and yet you were there, with sensitivity and care.

You helped me more than I can express and made such a difficult moment a little lighter.

Immense gratitude to all.
I visited the clinic to have my kitten spayed, and the service and care from everyone was exceptional! Thank you for taking such good care of my girl!

Kindness, excellent service, professionalism and above all, love for what they do, which is increasingly rare these days. My kittens (Bia, Eva and Lilly) are followed at this clinic by Dr. António. The affection they dedicate to my furry friends every time we go there is priceless.
I definitely recommend it.⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Best service with the best professionals in the field.
I recommend them for everything from veterinary care to bathing and grooming!
